အပြားအားဖြင့်-တည်-ဖြစ်-စေ၏။ （က） ထား၏။ （ခ） တီးမှုတ်-မြည်စေ-၏။ （ဂ） ပြောကြား-သိစေ-၏။
R:
paṭṭhapeti：ပ-ဋ္ဌပေတိ （ကာ） （ပ√ဌာ+ဏာပေ）
တည်စေ၏။ ဆောက်တည်စေ၏။ ဆောက်လုပ်၏။ ဖြစ်စေ၏။
စိတ္တံ ပဋ္ဌပေသိ၊ စိတ်အကြံကို ဖြစ်စေ၏။ ဒါနံ ပဋ္ဌပေသ၊ိ အလှုကို ဖြစ်စေ၏။ သိပ္ပံ ပဋ္ဌပေသုံ၊ အတတ်ကို သင်ကြားကုန်၏။ သာလံ ပဋ္ဌပေသုံ၊ ဇရပ်ကို ဆောက်လုပ်ကုန်၏။ အတ္တဘာဝေ ခယဝယံ ပဋ္ဌပေတုံ၊ ကိုယ်၏အဖြစ်၌ ကုန်ခြင်းပျက်ခြင်းကို နှလုံးထား၍ ဆောက်တည်ခြင်းငှာ။
U: PAṬṬHĀPETI：（pa+thā+āpe） thành lập，khởi sự，bắt đầu （làm gì） [aor] --esi [pp] --pita [abs] --petvā

( a ) paṭṭhapenta, mf (~entī) n. , Vin II 276, 14 (na anuvādo ~etabbo … ~entiyā āpatti dukkaṭassa, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ṭhapetabbo … ṭhapentiyā); Ja V 99, 22 (dhammadesanaṃ ~ento); Ps V 27, 8 (tīsu ṭhānesu satiṃ ~ento satipaṭṭhāne sevatī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sati ṭhapento); ( b ) paṭṭhapaya(t), paṭṭhāpaya(t), mfn. , Spk III 146, 26 (vipassanaṃ ~ayato, Ce so; Be, Se paṭṭhāpayato; Ee ṭhapayato); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) paṭṭhapesi, Vin III 66, 33 ; D II 235, 17 (imaṃ mahāpaṭhaviṃ uttarena āyataṃ dakkhiṇena sakaṭamukhaṃ sattadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhaji sabbāni sakaṭamukhāni paṭṭhapesi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee aṭṭhapesi); Ja I 486, 23 (kākānaṃ nibaddhaṃ dānaṃ ~esi); VI 225, 17 (attano micchāvādaṃ ~esi); Mil 3, 5 (mahesakkho mahātejo bhaveyyan ti paṭhamapatthanaṃ ~esi); Dhp-a III 222, 8 (satthā … abhidhammapiṭakaṃ ~esi); ( b ) paṭṭhapayi, Pv 21:35 (dānaṃ ~ayi Aṅkuro, Be so; Ce paṭṭhāpayi; Ee, Se paṭṭhayi; Pv-a 126, 23 : mahādānaṃ Aṅkuro ~esi); ( c ) paṭṭhayi,? Pv 21:35 (dānaṃ paṭṭhayi Aṅkuro, Ee, Se so, perhaps wr; Be paṭṭhapayi; Ce paṭṭhāpayi); 3 pl. ( a ) paṭṭhapesuṃ, Vin IV 272, 7 ; Ja I 200, 30 (vaḍḍhakiṃ pakkosāpetvā sālaṃ ~esuṃ); IV 391, 11 (sippaṃ ~esuṃ); 492, 7 (gehaṃ ~esuṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se patiṭṭhapesuṃ); ( b ) paṭṭhapayiṃsu, Ps III 288, 25 ; Mp IV 180, 21 (te ubho pi … ācariyassa santike sippaṃ paṭṭhapayiṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paṭṭhayiṃsu); ( c ) paṭṭhapiṃsu, Nidd II [ Be ] 125, 9 (… paññapiṃsu ~iṃsu …); — absol. ( a ) paṭṭhapetvā, Vin IV 15, 2 (padaṃ nāma ekato ~etvā ekato osāpenti); Ja IV 224, 21 (sippaṃ ~etvā); VI 399, 16 (chaṇakīḷaṃ ~etvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~etha); Ap 334, 13 (annaṃ pānaṃ ~etvā); Nidd-a I 202, 30 (yasmiṃ garubhāvaṃ ~etvā denti); — neg. apaṭṭhapetvā, Ja IV 308, 12 (ahaṃ aññe apaṭṭhapetvā attānaṃ yeva sodhetuṃ labhāmī ti); Dhp-a I 260, 21 (taṃ apaṭṭhapetvā, Ce, Ee so; Be avatvā; Se apatthetvā); ( b ) paṭṭhapetvāna, Ap 39, 7 (ārakkhaṃ ~etvāna); Mhv 37:88; — pass. part.pr. paṭṭhapiyamāna, mfn. , S III 139, 33 (desiyamāne paññāpiyamāne ~iyamāne …, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr paṭṭhiyamāne); — pp paṭṭhapita, mfn. [ cf S. prasthāpita], set forth; set going; Vin II 276, 14 (na anuvādo ~etabbo ~ito pi appaṭṭhapito, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ṭhapetabbo ṭhapito pi aṭhapito); S III 132, 6 (sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ ~itaṃ vivaṭaṃ …); Ja III 97, 15 (~itāni dhurabhattādīni); It-a I 113, 28 (āraddha ti ~itā); Pv-a 119, 24 (~itattā); — neg. appaṭṭhapita, mfn. , Vin II 276, 14 ; — supaṭṭhapita, mfn. , well or properly set forth; Nidd II [ Be ] 81, 25 ; — fpp paṭṭhapetabba, mfn. , Vin II 5, 14 (na anuvādo ~etabbo); Sv 753, 9 foll. (~etabbato paṭṭhānaṃ pavattayitabbato ti attho, kena ~etabbato ti satiyā) = Spk III 178, 35 foll. ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se kena ~etabbo ti) = Nidd-a I 48, 9 foll. ( eds ~etabbo ti); — see also paṭṭhāti, paṭṭhāya, patiṭṭhati.
